title: Annual peak flows of a river: the 100-year flood
intro: Illustrative data, made up for this book. The largest flow of each year at a river gauge for 25 years (m³/s). A lognormal distribution is fitted to the annual peaks; the 0.99 quantile is the 100-year flood (exceedance probability 0.01), and P(X > 800) the chance a year's peak exceeds 800 m³/s.
